# Clause– Suicide And Self-Harm Self-harm and related topics are allowed on SpL, but they are not acts to be done lightly. This is doubly true for suicide, which should be used solely as a last resort or a cumulation of mental anguish.
The key idea behind both of these actions is that they must make sense for the character. You have no justification for self-harm as an individual sound of mind and body with no major stresses or concerns.
## Self-Harm A character may enact self-harm based on personal stresses, mental disorders, or being generally shaken. While no AHelp is required to initiate self-harm behaviors, such actions should be done in moderation and within reason.
You should factor in your character and whether they would do this very carefully before engaging in any act of self-harm. Frivolous or unnecessarily frequent instances may result in a warning, or potentially direct disciplinary action.
## Suicide Even with the ease of revival, suicide must be treated seriously both by the victim and by any responders. You are making the choice to take your own life– carefully consider if [textlink="your behaviour makes sense" link="RPSpL1"].
[bold]You must receive admin permission via AHelp before attempting suicide[/bold]. The only exception to this rule is if you are committing the act to avoid capture, torture, and/or execution. This caveat should never come into play for the vast majority of players in the vast majority of situations.
Exceedingly poor interpretation of your situation or failure to clear a suicide with the admins will result in disciplinary action.
